turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste! Main Udaan Finserv ki taraf se Kavya bol rahi hoon, ek AI assistant. Kya meri baat Sarita Ji se ho rhi hai?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Sarita ji, aapne personal loan ke liye enquiry ki thi. Kya aap 2 minute baat kar sakti hain?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan mai free hoon. Accha Kitne tak ka loan milega aur byaj kitna dena hoga?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hamare QuickCash loan mein 50 hazaar se 10 lakh rupaye tak ka loan mil payega. Byaj/interest 13 se 24 percent saalana hai, aur aapko kitna rate milega ye aapki credit profile par depend karta hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okayy aur Processing fee kitni lagti hai?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Processing fee loan amount ka 2 percent plus GST hai, jo disbursal ke time kaat lii jaati hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Approval aapki credit assessment aur document verification par depend karti hai, isliye main approval ki guarantee to nahi dey sakti. Approval ke baad 24 se 48 ghante mein disbursal ho jata hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Theek hai, mai ready hoon apply karne ke liye.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Ji Zaroor. Main pakka aapko Aadhaar, PAN, 3 mahine ki bank statement aur income proof ki list WhatsApp par bhejti hoon.
